sp-acj4-1-cond

Given
\(x \in \mathbb{R},\quad \left|x\right| \le 1\)
Claim
\(\displaystyle \arcsin\left(\left|x\right|\right) = \left|\arcsin x\right|\)
Expected
true equal at every admissible point

the two sides are equal at every admissible point

SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[1] + rules.json[0]: asin abs _0 -> abs asin _0 [weakest assumption found: abs-le-1]

Lean proof: included

(case sp-acj4-1-cond (category simplipy-conditional)
  (note "SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[1] + rules.json[0]: asin abs _0  ->  abs asin _0  [weakest assumption found: abs-le-1]")
  (var x real)
  (assume (<= (abs x) 1))
  (ask (= (asin (abs x)) (abs (asin x))))
  (expect true)
  (lean-proof "obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := AE.IsReal.exists hd0; have hr : |r| ≤ 1 := (by simpa [AE.abs_ofReal] using h0.2); have hr' := abs_le.mp hr; refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩; rw [AE.abs_ofReal, AE.asin_ofReal (by linarith [abs_nonneg r]) hr, AE.asin_ofReal hr'.1 hr'.2, AE.abs_ofReal, AE.cond_arcsin_abs]"))
